bibl.title: Theodor Hopfner, Classical Philologist at the German University in Prague.
bibl.seg: Karla Vymetalová, Theodor Hopfner, Classical Philologist at the German University in Prague.
bibl.note: Theodor Hopfner was professor of Classical Philology at the German University in Prague. As a consequence of his friendly relationship with the Austrian papyrologist Carl Wessely, the papyri from the latter's private collection were brought to Prague, to become the P. Wessely Pragenses.
